$schema_note: Per-project customization for godmode1. Copy this file to a project root and edit. Every command reads it; nothing is hardcoded to a language or stack.

project.name: UNNAMED_PROJECT
project._type_options: auto | web-frontend | backend-api | cli | library | mobile | data | infra | other
project.summary: One-sentence description of what this project does and who it is for.

commands._note: Set the real shell command for each, or leave 'auto' to let godmode1 detect from manifest files (package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, go.mod, etc.).

workflow._note: Remove steps to skip them. Order is fixed: optimize never runs before review passes.
workflow._strictness_options: low (suggest) | medium (warn) | high (block on failed review)

conventions.style_guide: Follow existing repo conventions; infer from neighbouring files before introducing new patterns.
forbidden: disabling tests to make CI pass

checklist: Does each change map to a planned step?
Are edge cases and empty/null/boundary inputs handled?
Any unhandled error paths or silent failures?
Are new dependencies justified and pinned?
Did tests run and pass? Is new behaviour covered?
Any obvious performance or security regression?
